endpoints.summary: List or search all assets (synchronous) - Group scope (Early Access)

details.description:
Retrieves a polymorphic list of all asset types for a given group.
The tenant is resolved from the group_id.

#### Required permissions

- `View Groups (group.read)`

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.description: The requested API version
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Comma-separated sort fields. Prefix with `-` for descending order.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Number of results to return per page
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Cursor for fetching the next page of results
parameters.name: starting_after

parameters.description: Cursor for fetching the previous page of results
parameters.name: ending_before

200.description: Successful response with a polymorphic list of assets

endpoints.summary: Bulk update asset attributes - Group scope (Early Access)

details.description:
Partially updates multiple assets within a group context.
Maximum of 100 assets can be updated per request.
The operation is transactional - all updates succeed or all fail.

#### Required permissions

- `Edit Group Details (group.edit)`

parameters.name: group_id

parameters.name: version

endpoints.summary: Get filter value suggestions (autocomplete) - Group scope (Early Access)

details.description:
Returns a list of distinct values for a specific filter field.
Useful for building autocomplete functionality in filter UIs.

Use the UUID from the filter fields list endpoint to identify which field to query.

For object filter values, both the keys and values are returned.

#### Required permissions

- `View Groups (group.read)`

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.description: The requested API version
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: The UUID of the filter field to get values for (from the filter fields list endpoint)
parameters.name: filter_id

parameters.description: Full text search term to filter the list of values. If keys_only is true, this will filter the keys of the object filter values. If key is provided, this will filter the value for the specific key of the object filter values.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Number of results to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Cursor for fetching the next page of results
parameters.name: starting_after

parameters.description: Cursor for fetching the previous page of results
parameters.name: ending_before

parameters.description: Return only the keys of the object filter values
parameters.name: keys_only

parameters.description: Return only the value for a specific key of the object filter values
parameters.name: key

endpoints.summary: Get available group fields - Group scope (Early Access)

details.description:
Returns a list of valid group field names that can be used for grouping assets within a group context.
Common fields such as `class` and `org_id` (the Snyk organization that discovered the asset) apply to
every asset type; grouping by `org_id` returns one bucket per organization in the group.

#### Required permissions

- `View Groups (group.read)`

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.description: The requested API version
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of asset types to filter group fields
parameters.name: asset_types

parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination
parameters.name: starting_after

parameters.description: Cursor for backward pagination
parameters.name: ending_before

details.summary: Get available group fields - Group scope (Early Access)

endpoints.summary: Get group value aggregation - Group scope (Early Access)

details.description:
Returns aggregated values for a specific group field id, showing the count of assets
for each distinct value.

Use the UUID from the group fields list endpoint to identify which field to query.

Grouping by `org_id` buckets assets by the Snyk organization that discovered them:
one bucket per organization at group or tenant scope, and a single bucket at org scope.

#### Required permissions

- `View Groups (group.read)`

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.description: The requested API version
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: The UUID of the group field to get values for (from the group fields list endpoint)
parameters.name: group_field_id

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of asset types to filter the aggregation
parameters.name: asset_types

parameters.description: Maximum number of group values to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination
parameters.name: starting_after

parameters.description: Cursor for backward pagination
parameters.name: ending_before

data.description: Polymorphic array of asset objects of different types

Component.description: A component in software, such as a library or package dependency

count.description: Number of components in the SBOM

description.description: Free form text description of this component

version.description: The version of the component, e.x. 0.2.0

LabelsReplace.description:
Full replacement of all labels on the asset.
All existing labels will be removed and replaced with the provided labels.

GroupValueIssuesAggregation.description:
Aggregated issue counts from discovery sources across all assets in this group.
Counts are summed from all project-type discovery sources.

critical.description: Total count of critical severity issues

high.description: Total count of high severity issues

low.description: Total count of low severity issues

medium.description: Total count of medium severity issues

total.description: Sum of all issue counts (critical + high + medium + low)

asset_types.description: List of asset types this field applies to

name.description: The field name used in RSQL filters (e.g., "class", "registry")

type.description: Data type of the field (string, boolean, datetime, array, object)

ImageConfig.description:
Runtime configuration for the container (OCI image config).
Contains entrypoint, environment, exposed ports, volumes, labels, etc.

exposed_ports.description:
Exposed ports in format "port/protocol" (e.g., "8080/tcp", "53/udp").
Port is 0-65535, protocol is tcp or udp.

labels.description: Key-value labels from the image configuration

VcsReference.description: A reference to a version control system, with optional branch, tag, or revision information

url.description: A link to the VCS repository

Party.description: A group / team / individual, such as an author of a piece of software

email.description: An email which can be used to contact this party

uri.description: URL or URI referring to the party, if available

LabelsUpdate.description:
Updates the asset's labels by adding or removing label values.
At least one of 'add' or 'remove' must be provided.

add.description:
Labels to add to the asset.
Labels must be 1-40 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and _/:?#@&=+%~- symbols.

remove.description:
Labels to remove from the asset.
Labels must be 1-40 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and _/:?#@&=+%~- symbols

DistributionDigest.description: Distribution digest information for a container image

PolymorphicAssetData.description: JSON:API data for any asset type (polymorphic)

id.description: The unique identifier of the asset

relationships.description: JSON:API relationships linking to related resources

projects.description: Link to the asset's related projects

related.description: URL to the related projects endpoint

targets.description: Link to the asset's related targets

related.description: URL to the related targets endpoint

id.description: UUID identifier for the group field

related.description: Relative path to get aggregated values for this group field

id.description: UUID identifier for the group value

ProvenanceAttestation.description: A provenance attestation describing how a container image manifest was built

build_config_commit.description: Git commit of the build config that produced the image

build_type.description: Build type URI identifying the build definition format

builder_id.description: Identity of the builder that produced the attestation

manifest_digest.description: Manifest digest of the image this attestation attests

repository_uri.description: URI of the repository hosting the build config

source_attestation_digest.description: Digest of the attestation manifest descriptor itself

History.description: A single entry in the container image build history

empty_layer.description: Whether this is an empty layer (metadata-only)

allOf.description: Attributes specific to container image assets.

image_tags.description: Distinct image tags across all discovery sources

provenance_attestations.description: Provenance attestations describing how the image was built

size_bytes.description: Size of the image in bytes

total_image_tags.description: Total count of distinct image tags across all discovery sources

TagsUpdate.description:
Updates the asset's tags by adding or removing key-value pairs.
Both add and remove can be specified in the same request.
If a tag key appears in both add and remove, the request will fail.

add.description:
Tags to add to the asset (key-value pairs).
Tag keys must be 1-30 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.
Tag values must be up to 40 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and _/:?#@&=+%~- symbols.

remove.description:
Tag keys to remove from the asset.
Tag keys must be 1-30 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.

data.description: List of group values with their aggregated metadata

id.description: The unique identifier of the asset

OrgContext.description: Service catalog enrichment from org-context connectors

application.description: Parent application this service belongs to

catalog_name.description: Identifier for this service in the catalog system

owner.description: Owning team or person as recorded in the service catalog

title.description: Human-readable display title of the service

next.description: Link to the next page (if available)

prev.description: Link to the previous page (if available)

RepositoryLanguage.description: Programming language detected in a repository

byte_count.description: Number of bytes of code in this language

integrity_hash.description: Integrity hash of the SBOM document

lifecycles.description: Lifecycles, e.x. one of cyclonedx.model.lifecycle.LifecyclePhase ('design', 'pre-build', etc)

sbom_created_at.description: When the SBOM was generated, ISO 8601 format. Can be distinct from created_at

sbom_standard.description: SBOM standard / format used to generate this asset

serialization.description: Serialization format used to encode this asset

spec_version.description: SBOM spec version as provided, for example 1.6, 2.3, 3.0.1.

fork.description: Whether the repository is a fork

is_personal.description: Whether the repository is a personal repository

languages.description: Programming languages detected in the repository

last_sync.description: When the repository was last synced from the SCM

pushed_at.description: When code was last pushed to the repository

scm_id.description: SCM-specific identifier (GitHub numeric ID, GitLab project ID, etc.)

url.description: Web browse URL of the repository (natural key, unique per tenant)

TagsReplace.description:
Full replacement of all tags on the asset.
All existing tags will be removed and replaced with the provided tags.

OperatingSystem.description: Operating system for container images (Go GOOS conventions)

RootFs.description:
Root filesystem information with ordered layer diff IDs.
Each diff_id is a SHA256 digest of the uncompressed layer content.

diff_ids.description: Diff IDs for each layer (SHA256 of uncompressed content)

key.description: For object-type filters (e.g., tags), the key name. Only present for object-type filter values.

value.description: The filter value. For simple filters, this is the value itself. For object-type filters (e.g., tags), this is the value associated with the key.

asset_types.description: List of asset types this field applies to

name.description: The field name used for grouping (e.g., "class", "registry")

id.description: UUID identifier for the filter value

AssetPatchAttributes.description:
Attributes that can be updated via PATCH.
At least one attribute must be provided.
Labels and tags support add/remove operations for atomic modifications.

class.description: Asset classification for input. Either display_name or rank must be provided.

AssetBaseAttributes.description: Asset-level fields shared across all asset types.

last_seen_at.description:
When the asset was last seen (i.e., confirmed to exist) via any discovery source.
Updated on every upsert operation.

org_ids.description:
Every org the asset belongs to within the requested scope, sourced from the
asset scope summary: a tenant-scoped read lists all orgs in the tenant, a
group-scoped read only those under the group, and an org-scoped read only
the requested org. Only populated for scan-backed asset types (container
images and SBOMs); omitted for repository assets.

origin_timestamp.description: The asset's source-defined timestamp — when the underlying artifact was created at its origin (e.g. a container image's build time or an SBOM's generation time). Distinct from created_at, which is when the asset record was created in Snyk. Null when unknown.

scan_engines.description: Scan engines applied to the asset

updated_at.description: When the asset was last updated

Architecture.description: CPU architecture for container images (Go GOARCH conventions)

ScanEngine.description: Scan engine information associated with an asset

last_seen.description: When the scan engine was last seen

link.description: Link to the scan engine details

GroupValueMeta.description:
Computed aggregations across all assets within this group value.
Fields are only present when explicitly requested via the `meta_fields` query parameter.
If `meta_fields` is not specified, the meta object is omitted from the response.

built_at.description:
Aggregated container image build timestamp across all assets in this group.
The aggregation function is controlled by the `aggregate[built_at]` parameter (default: last).
Null if no assets have a built_at value.

count.description: Number of assets with this value.

created_at.description:
Aggregated created_at timestamp across assets in this group.
The aggregation function is controlled by the `aggregate[created_at]` parameter (default: last).
Null if no assets have a created_at value.

labels.description:
Unique labels across all assets in this group.
Limited to the first 1000 unique labels (alphabetically sorted).
Empty array if no assets have labels.

last_seen_at.description:
Aggregated last_seen_at timestamp across all assets in this group.
The aggregation function is controlled by the `aggregate[last_seen_at]` parameter (default: last).
Null if no assets have a last_seen_at value.

risk_score.description:
Aggregated risk_score from discovery sources across all assets in this group.
The aggregation function is controlled by the `aggregate[risk_score]` parameter (default: last).
Derived from project-type discovery sources. Null if no assets have
discovery sources with risk scores.

tags.description:
Unique tags across all assets in this group.
Limited to the first 1000 unique tags (alphabetically sorted).
Empty array if no assets have tags.

updated_at.description:
Aggregated updated_at timestamp across all assets in this group.
The aggregation function is controlled by the `aggregate[updated_at]` parameter (default: last).

DockerfileMetadata.description: Dockerfile metadata extracted from a BuildKit provenance attestation

dockerfile_name.description: Name of the Dockerfile used for the build
